nodes.name: check_outputs.sh
nodes.summary: CI helper that locates the latest scenario result artifacts (aggregate CSV, JSONL, and annual CSV) in an output directory and prints their headers and first rows for quick sanity inspection. Exits non-zero when the directory or expected outputs are missing.

nodes.name: ci_phase_c_full.sh
nodes.summary: Phase C CI orchestration script that sequentially runs finance IRR/debt tests, the scenario matrix validator, CLI smokes, heavy Monte-Carlo/sensitivity/optimization modules, reporting, and charts smokes. Tolerates individual step failures to gather full-phase coverage.

nodes.name: ci_quick.sh
nodes.summary: Fast local CI driver that activates the project venv and runs a quick sequence of smoke checks: API/adapter coverage, import-surface sweep, heavy module shims, reporting/core stacks, and fast CLI scenarios. Warns rather than fails when optional sub-scripts are absent.

nodes.name: dev_quickcheck.sh
nodes.summary: Developer pre-commit quickcheck that formats v14 analytics/finance files with black and isort, runs mypy on the analytics/finance surfaces, then executes focused analytics-layer tests followed by the full pytest suite. Embodies the project's Go-with-the-Flow lint-then-test discipline.
